source.observation: The public homepage returned HTTP 200 and exposed ninety linked portfolio cards at the observation time.

evidence_boundary.rule: E3 applies only to reachability and card display on the source homepage. A linked card, detail route, marketing statement, or unmarked card does not prove production, ownership, legal, commerce, API, SSO, AI/ML, cryptographic, rights, or deployment state.

scope.count_semantics: mixed public card census, not a homogeneous platform count
excluded_claims: blockchain, token, DAO, DID, ZKP, fingerprint, or vault operation

type_vocabulary.platform: A candidate software, service, marketplace, media, directory, or operating surface.
type_vocabulary.brand: A public-facing brand, imprint, product family, or commercial identity.
type_vocabulary.program: A participation, partner, wholesale, impact, incentive, or operating program.
type_vocabulary.framework: A named institutional method, architecture, operating model, or engine.
type_vocabulary.governance: A rule, control, authority, stewardship, risk, or continuity construct.
type_vocabulary.support: A documentation, help, service, or support architecture surface.
type_vocabulary.status: A roadmap, health, incident, or lifecycle communication surface.
type_vocabulary.concept: A public architecture concept requiring decomposition before canonical implementation mapping.

shared_defaults.unmarked_card_meaning: displayed without an Archived label; current lifecycle and implementation remain unverified
shared_defaults.archived_card_meaning: the public card explicitly included an Archived label; no deletion or reactivation is authorized
shared_defaults.detail_route_state: linked_from_observed_public_homepage; target workflow and feature state not certified by this manifest
shared_defaults.promotion_rule: No entry in this manifest may be used alone to promote an entity to active, production, purchasable, licensed, integrated, certified, or legally established.

conflicts.subject: portfolio count and entity typing
conflicts.summary: The homepage shows ninety mixed cards, including eighty without an Archived label and ten with one, while public copy also uses 80+ and 60+ platform language.

conflicts.subject: unmarked card semantics
conflicts.summary: An unmarked card is not treated as current production; it remains unverified until a stronger registry and operational evidence agree.

conflicts.subject: ChainCliques lifecycle
conflicts.summary: The homepage card is unmarked, while the governed long-tail registry describes ChainCliques as sunset brand reserve.

conflicts.subject: AI studio family
conflicts.summary: NeuralCraft, Thrive AI Studio, ThriveStudio, CrownThrive Studios, and recovered NeuralCraft AI Studio language require typed alias and successor resolution.

conflicts.subject: CrownRewards naming
conflicts.summary: The card uses My CrownRewards while other public and governed records use CrownRewards.

conflicts.subject: CrownApps and ThriveApps naming
conflicts.summary: CrownApps and ThriveApps resolve to the same candidate platform family pending final public branding authority.

conflicts.subject: CrownOasis lifecycle
conflicts.summary: The public card is unmarked and a separate CrownOasis surface is reachable, while the governed long-tail overlay records My CrownOasis as reserve.

conflicts.subject: Melanated Voices naming
conflicts.summary: Melanated Voices and Melanated Voices TV appear in source families; their umbrella, service, and channel relationship is not resolved here.

conflicts.subject: Virality Music and CrownThrive Music lineage
conflicts.summary: CrownThrive Music may be an umbrella or lineage name for Virality Music; no duplicate platform, rights, catalog, or commerce state is created.

conflicts.subject: ThriveStudio lineage
conflicts.summary: The governed long-tail overlay treats ThriveStudio as a predecessor under CrownThrive Studios and as distinct from AdLuxe Studio, despite the unmarked homepage card.

conflicts.subject: MM Suites typed split
conflicts.summary: The framework identity and any implementation-facing platform surface remain separate; physical, franchise, regional, and legal activation are not established.

conflicts.subject: ThriveSupport family
conflicts.summary: ThriveSupport, CrownThrive Support, the Mintlify projection, and the sparse legacy public help application require projection and successor mapping.

conflicts.subject: CHLOM typed split and capability claims
conflicts.summary: ct.framework.chlom is distinct from implementation-facing ct.platform.chlom; public AI, blockchain, token, DAO, DID, ZKP, fingerprint, patent, and vault language is not implementation proof.

conflicts.subject: CIE expansion
conflicts.summary: The homepage uses Cultural Imprint Engine while a legacy support surface uses Cultural Impact Engine; this manifest preserves Imprint without deleting the conflicting observation.

conflicts.subject: archived cards
conflicts.summary: The ten explicit Archived labels are preserved exactly and cannot be overridden by roster memory or adjacent active brands without a governed lifecycle decision.

conflicts.subject: CII and ThriveFund legal form
conflicts.summary: CII and ThriveFund cards are program/framework observations, not proof of nonprofit, fund, charity, securities, tax, or separate-entity status.

validation_contract.archived_projection_rule: Every archived summary item must resolve to one card with observed_card_marker archived.
validation_contract.route_rule: Every card retains the exact detail route linked by the observed source homepage.

governance.correction_model: append_and_reconcile; preserve observed names, aliases, conflicts, archived labels, and route lineage
governance.rollback: remove this candidate manifest and its companion atlas without changing canonical entity records, docs navigation, source homepage, or production systems
